package.description: Convert legacy Microsoft Works files to DOCX, XLSX, PDF, and CSV locally on Windows.

en-US.description: Convert legacy Microsoft Works files to DOCX, XLSX, PDF, and CSV locally on Windows.
en-US.longDescription:
Bulk-convert Microsoft Works documents and spreadsheets (.wps, .wks, .wdb, .xlr) to DOCX, XLSX, PDF, and CSV locally on Windows.
LibreOffice is bundled with the installer, so no additional software is required.
en-US.name: Microsoft Works File Converter
